component.name: EasySearch
component.summary: Instant file and content search across your filesystem

description.p: EasySearch searches file names and file contents as you type, and keeps its index up to date in realtime as files are created, renamed, changed and deleted.
It is a lightweight native desktop application: no runtime and no web view, and it never accesses the network.

ul.li: Realtime index kept fresh by kernel filesystem events (inotify)
Everything-style queries: globs, multiple terms, exclusion, regex
Content search powered by the embedded ripgrep engine, always current
Word, OpenDocument and PDF text searched in-process, with no external tools
Live previews: images, media, documents, Markdown and syntax-highlighted code
Tags, saved searches, tabs and quick location filters
Dark, light and brand themes; your choice is remembered
A tray icon, a duplicate finder that moves copies to the Trash, and a scriptable CLI

screenshot.caption: Realtime filename and content search, in the dark theme
The same window in the light theme

description.p: Realtime filename and content search with a native GUI, tray, tags, excluded folders, live previews and a recoverable duplicate finder — fully offline. This release adds quick-action buttons, a versioned window title, and default exclusions for virtual environments and dependency trees.
